key_concepts: Throwing chemical wastes into rivers harms aquatic organisms
Bleach water should not be thrown on plants because it harms growth
Reusing plastic containers reduces waste disposal
Burying rotting plant and food waste enriches soil through decomposition
Deforestation causes habitat loss and contributes to climate change
Trees absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen
Improper waste disposal can contaminate soil and water
Overconsumption of natural resources leads to habitat destruction and soil erosion
Pesticides and preservatives can leach into soil and water and harm health
The 5Rs—Reduce, Reuse, Recycle, Rot, Repair—help prevent harmful environmental changes
Waste segregation and recycling help minimize pollution
